exposure: delay in performing a caesarean section (CS)
Delay in performing a caesarean section (>1 hour vs <1 hour)
finding: A delay of more than 3 hours in performing a cesarean section, primarily due to family decision-making for consent, was associated with higher odds of severe maternal outcomes but lower odds of stillbirth.
mod_finding: Delays in performing cesarean section, particularly those exceeding 3 hours, were associated with a higher risk of severe maternal outcomes.
